en: Colorized view of Ljubljana's central square with the Baroque Franciscan Church of the Annunciation on the left, the Prešeren Monument in the foreground, and ornate Secession-era buildings on the right. The front caption reads "Ljubljana – Marijin trg." The reverse shows handwritten message, an Austrian green stamp with a Laibach (Ljubljana) postmark, and an address to Vienna.
